title: CreateDeploymentRequest
description: Request body for POST /file/manifest. Represents a deployment sequence submitted by a client (e.g. UI).

_id.description: Optional existing deployment id (ObjectId hex). Not used for POST create; used when resolving/updating in solver flows.

sequence.description: Ordered list of steps. Each step must specify module + function. Device may be empty/any/null to let orchestrator choose a compatible device.

device.description: Device identifier: MongoDB ObjectId hex, OR device name, OR empty/any/null to auto-select.

module.description: Module identifier: MongoDB ObjectId hex OR module name.

func.description: Exported wasm function name to execute on this step.
